title: Recording now available for the April 9, 2026 KPN Webinar!
bodyHtml:
MacKenzie Brandes showcased what’s new in the Common Metabolic Diseases Knowledge Portal (CMDKP).

This session gave an exclusive first look at the latest production release designed to accelerate discovery and empower your research.

What you’ll learn:
? A walkthrough of new data, features, and tools
⚙️ Practical tips on how to get the most out of the latest updates
? Insider insights into what we built and why it matters

The recording is now live: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kRas5-gFINg
summary: Unable to join today's Knowledge Portal Network webinar? The recording is now live.
